  - Five of the deals are at clients that already had the same product. In each case the earlier facility is still active or was charged off, so the new ones look like added credit rather than replacements.
  - If your scorecard nets out renewals or counts only the increase on existing lines, the totals would change.
- **Not used:** A draft RM scorecard table in the sandbox area (`SANDBOX.RM_SCORECARD_DRAFT`). It isn't an official source.

sql.sql: select r.*, g.fqtr, g.new_commit_goal from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_GOAL g on g.rm_id=r.rm_id where r.team ilike '%east%' or r.team ilike '%C%I%' order by r.team, r.rm_id
select team, region, segment_cd, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER group by 1,2,3 order by 1
select fqtr, count(*), count(distinct rm_id), sum(new_commit_goal) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_GOAL group by 1

select facility_status, product_cd, count(*), sum(commit_amt), min(orig_dt), max(orig_dt), sum(iff(orig_dt between '2026-07-01' and '2026-09-30',1,0)) q3_cnt from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 1,2 order by 1,2

with q as (select f.*, c.rm_id client_rm, c.segment_cd cseg from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c on c.cif_no=f.cif_no where f.orig_dt between '2026-07-01' and '2026-09-30')
select r.rm_id, r.rm_nm,
 count(distinct iff(q.orig_rm_id=r.rm_id, q.facility_id, null)) n_orig,
 sum(iff(q.orig_rm_id=r.rm_id, q.commit_amt, 0)) amt_orig,
 count(iff(q.orig_rm_id=r.rm_id, q.facility_id, null)) rows_orig,
 count(distinct iff(q.client_rm=r.rm_id, q.facility_id, null)) n_client,
 sum(iff(q.client_rm=r.rm_id, q.commit_amt, 0)) amt_client,
 sum(iff(q.orig_rm_id=r.rm_id and q.commit_amt is null,1,0)) null_amt
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r cross join q
where r.team='C&I East' group by 1,2 order by 1

select count(*), count(distinct facility_id), count(distinct cif_no), sum(iff(orig_rm_id is null,1,0)) null_rm, sum(iff(c.cif_no is null,1,0)) no_client, sum(iff(f.orig_rm_id<>c.rm_id,1,0)) rm_mismatch, sum(commit_amt) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c using (cif_no) where orig_dt between '2026-07-01' and '2026-09-30'

select f.orig_rm_id, f.facility_id, f.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.segment_cd, f.product_cd, f.commit_amt, f.orig_dt, f.maturity_dt, f.facility_status, f.risk_rating,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY p where p.cif_no=f.cif_no and p.product_cd=f.product_cd and p.orig_dt<f.orig_dt) prior_same_prod
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c on c.cif_no=f.cif_no
where f.orig_dt between '2026-07-01' and '2026-09-30' and f.orig_rm_id in (select rm_id from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER where team='C&I East') order by 1, f.orig_dt

select f.facility_id new_fac, p.facility_id prior_fac, p.product_cd, p.commit_amt, p.orig_dt, p.maturity_dt, p.facility_status, p.payoff_dt
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY p on p.cif_no=f.cif_no and p.product_cd=f.product_cd and p.orig_dt<f.orig_dt
where f.facility_id in ('F0002220','F0002222','F0002236','F0002239','F0002240') order by 1,5
